write_up: You’re aiming for IT support, with a school help desk internship and earlier device work at Peachtree Electronics. It’s common for an early-career resume to list the basic tasks without showing how much work came through. Here, that makes it difficult to compare your internship with other support experience, and no work is dated after May 2025.

The Active Directory line is your best model: it names the tool and the account work you did. Your degree and CompTIA A+ are useful for this direction, but Experience currently sits below Education even though you also have retail experience.

Let’s start with the time since the internship, then add the kinds of tickets and the laptop setup work you can describe accurately. Move Experience above Education so a recruiter reaches that work sooner.
